scope: HF-hosted EEG corpus expansion; distinct canonical corpora only. Availability is not equivalent to download or benchmark readiness.

datasets.task: Mental-workload classification from 2 s EEG windows; HF/MONSTER label is self-rating >4 versus <=4.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (HF card cites the upstream IEEE DataPort release)
datasets.access: Anonymous HF download; upstream page may use its own delivery flow.
datasets.downloadStatus: Full minimal modeling payload downloaded: X, y, subject IDs, five supplied split files, card and loader; CSV duplicate omitted.
datasets.readiness: Strongest near-term new track after protocol review.
datasets.risks: Windows overlap heavily (2 s length; exact stride requires confirmation from preprocessing provenance); evaluate at subject level. Supplied five participant-level holdouts overlap with each other and are not a disjoint 5-fold partition. Card label definition must not be replaced by rest-versus-task condition without upstream reconstruction.

datasets.canonicalCorpus: Cavanagh 2018 Parkinson EEG (resting-state complement to Cavanagh2018a oddball)
datasets.task: Parkinson disease versus matched control from eyes-open/eyes-closed resting EEG; paired cohort context with auditory oddball repository Cavanagh2018a.
datasets.license: PDDL 1.0 in mirrored LICENSE; verify upstream rightsholder grant before redistribution.
datasets.access: Anonymous HF files; no gate observed.
datasets.downloadStatus: One raw subject/session file downloaded and parsed; 19,231,069 bytes of 2,088,747,973-byte repository.
datasets.risks: HF uploader is a mirror, not creator. PD participants can have two medication sessions while controls generally have one; splits must be by person, not file. Sample has 67 channels, including non-scalp channels; card describes 64 scalp channels.

datasets.task: Reward-processing ERP / Parkinson classification; probabilistic feedback with medication ON/OFF sessions.
datasets.license: PDDL 1.0 in mirrored LICENSE; upstream authority not independently reconfirmed.
datasets.risks: 18.3 GB; participant grouping is mandatory because PD participants repeat across medication sessions. Mirrored release and bad-channel metadata require careful reconstruction.

datasets.task: Flanker response-conflict/error-related negativity and high/low obsessive-compulsive symptom grouping.
datasets.license: PDDL 1.0 in mirrored LICENSE; upstream authority not independently reconfirmed.
datasets.readiness: Potential ERP/cognitive-control track after event and sampling audit.
datasets.risks: Raw and “ready” CNT variants coexist and may duplicate participants; sampling rate is file-defined and not stated in the card; psychometric thresholding and covariates need a frozen protocol.

datasets.task: Schizophrenia/control and reinforcement learning under Simon conflict.
datasets.license: PDDL 1.0 in mirrored LICENSE; upstream authority not independently reconfirmed.
datasets.risks: Large preprocessed release; one file is in Not_used and uploader states exclusion reason is uncertain. Freeze usable-participant inventory before scoring.

datasets.task: 3 s versus 7 s interval timing and Parkinson/control cognition; subset has medication ON/OFF sessions.
datasets.license: PDDL 1.0 in mirrored LICENSE; upstream authority not independently reconfirmed.
datasets.risks: Card states 83 PD plus 37 controls; nine PD participants have repeated ON/OFF sessions whose pair mapping must be reconstructed. Split strictly by person.

datasets.task: Eyes-open versus eyes-closed resting-state classification on consumer EEG.
datasets.license: Other on HF/MONSTER card; upstream reuse terms must be checked.
datasets.access: Anonymous HF repository; processed arrays require no account.
datasets.downloadStatus: Not downloaded; card and repository metadata audited.
datasets.readiness: Good low-cost-device robustness candidate after license resolution.
datasets.risks: Only 13 of 60 recruits completed both conditions; 2 s windows use a 32-sample stride and are highly overlapping. Original acquisition was 2048 Hz then downsampled; three Emotiv device variants are mixed.

datasets.task: Binary arousal and valence classification from 2 s consumer EEG windows during audiovisual emotion elicitation.
datasets.license: Other on both HF/MONSTER cards; do not infer an open license from public availability.
datasets.downloadStatus: Not downloaded; both cards audited and counted as one canonical cohort.
datasets.readiness: Potential affect track only after license and split audit.
datasets.risks: DREAMERA and DREAMERV are two labels/preparations of the same participants and must not count as two datasets. Strongly overlapping windows and self-report thresholding; separate repositories duplicate X.

datasets.license: HF mirror has no license field; upstream THINGS-EEG2 terms must govern.
datasets.access: Anonymous HF Parquet, but repository is 54.4 GB and rows embed images/features.
datasets.downloadStatus: Not downloaded; schema/card audited. Multiple caption variants excluded as mirrors of the same EEG corpus.
datasets.risks: HF schema reports 63x250 float32 EEG but mixes EEG, stimulus images and derived embeddings; verify whether 250 samples represent a 1 s epoch and the exact upstream preprocessing. Prevent image/text label leakage.

datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 on HF card; verify against upstream repository files for redistribution.
datasets.downloadStatus: Repository files inspected then waveform payload not retained; card/schema audited.
datasets.readiness: Feature-only, not suitable for raw-waveform FM benchmark.
datasets.risks: Despite “raw” in the repo title, fields are band_power [time,20], motion [time,6], HSI and artifact flags; no voltage waveform field. HF split uses 27 participants, while the upstream paper reports 43, so this is a subset.

datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 on HF card and Frontiers article.
datasets.readiness: High-value SSVEP track, too large for this bounded fetch.
datasets.risks: Distributed data are preprocessed/downsampled tensors; first 15 subjects use shorter trial design than subjects 16–70. Protocol must respect subject and block structure.

datasets.task: EEG-conditioned attended-speaker extraction / left-right auditory attention.
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on HF derivative card; upstream Zenodo terms also apply.
datasets.access: Anonymous HF WebDataset, 7.19 GB repository / 3.09 GB current viewer payload.
datasets.risks: Modified derivative mixes speech and EEG, not canonical raw release. Upstream data were recorded at 8192 Hz then filtered, artifact-cleaned and downsampled to 128 Hz. Published warning identifies strong eye-gaze shortcut bias.

datasets.task: Naturalistic audiovisual narrative alignment across EEG, fMRI and video.
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 on HF card; audiovisual stimulus rights and participant-data terms need separate review.
datasets.access: Anonymous HF repository, about 193 GB total.
datasets.risks: Only six participants; EEG payload is preprocessed and segmented. Card/community discussion documents corrected upload issues; pin revision. TV episode redistribution rights may differ from EEG-data license.

datasets.task: Large-scale RSVP visual decoding on affordable consumer EEG across repeated sessions.
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 tag plus dataset-specific terms in card; research/noncommercial restrictions apply.
datasets.access: Anonymous repository browsing; full release 134 GB and card includes additional terms.
datasets.readiness: Excellent future low-cost/cross-session stress test, too large for MVP.
datasets.risks: Noncommercial/share-alike and additional dataset terms; 1.6M highly structured image trials can leak stimulus identity. Four sessions per subject (one retake) require subject/session-aware splits.

datasets.canonicalCorpus: ACM MM 2026 EEG-fNIRS Handwriting Trajectory Challenge
datasets.task: Four-class imagined-handwriting classification from synchronized EEG and fNIRS.
datasets.access: HF gate is auto; 20 train subjects and 10 test subjects, 15.78 GB repository.
datasets.readiness: Interesting competition track, but gated and hidden-label oriented.
datasets.risks: Test labels are not public; BDF annotations were removed. Channel count and sampling rate are not stated in the HF card and must be read from BDF headers after access. Noncommercial terms.

deduplicationNotes: DREAMERA and DREAMERV are one canonical DREAMER cohort with different labels.
perottofederico THINGS-EEG caption/single-subject variants and other THINGS-EEG uploads are mirrors/derivatives of THINGS-EEG2, counted once.
EEGDash repositories are metadata pointers to OpenNeuro/NEMAR, not HF-hosted waveform copies, and are excluded from this count.
JLB seizure_eeg train/dev/eval shards and smam CHB-MIT windows are derivatives of restricted/upstream CHB-MIT/TUH-family data; uploader tags cannot replace upstream terms.
Synthetic, text-only, image-rendered, and feature-only uploads are not counted as raw-waveform benchmark-ready datasets.
